thesis: The podcast argues that the U.S. approach to AI policy has shifted dramatically from a two-year-old consensus to pause or shut down open-source AI to a current posture of pushing to lead the global race. This cultural shift is attributed to a realization that earlier fears, such as the idea that open-source AI would give China an advantage, were empirically incorrect, and that the industry has moved from wanting to regulate technology in its infancy to allowing it to mature before deciding on regulation.
